problems.statement: A circular target with a radius of 12 inches is to have a circular bull’s-eye painted in the center so that the area of the bull’s-eye is 1% of the total area of the target. What should the radius of the bull’s-eye be?

She overtakes her hat just as she returns to the original starting point. What was the speed of the current?
